title: Ruleset hardening: promote AS0022, AA0087, AW0003, AA0203, AL0717 to Error
summary: Five analyzer rules (AS0022, AA0087, AW0003, AA0203, AL0717) are promoted from Warning to Error by removing their overrides from the shared ruleset, with targeted pragmas added to suppress specific violations.
key_points: Five AL analyzer rules moved back to Error severity in the ruleset hierarchy
94 ruleset overrides reduced to 89 by removing five rule suppression entries
Each remaining violation suppressed with narrowly scoped pragmas rather than repo-wide disabling
Violations ranged from none to three across 1-2 files per rule
Scope established through comprehensive diagnostic census from green CI builds covering 855 of 877 projects
